title: An integer multiplicity cycle from a boundary relation ∂B = T₂ + (−1)^p T₁
statement: Let P, n, p ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, B ∈ 𝒟_{n+2}(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U (n+1+1)) and integer multiplicity T₁, T₂ ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(U) such that ∂B(ω) = T₂(ω) + (−1)^p·T₁(ω) for every test (n+1)-form ω in U. Then there are Z, E' ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(U) such that Z is integer multiplicity, ∂Z = 0 (BoundaryVanishes Z), spt Z ⊆ spt B, M(E') ≤ M(T₂), and Z(ω) = T₁(ω) + E'(ω) for every test (n+1)-form ω in U. (Z = (−1)^p ∂B, E' = (−1)^p T₂.)
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (B : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1 + 1)) (T₁ T₂ : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)) (p : ℕ), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity T₁ → IsIntegerMultiplicity T₂ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (n + 1), B.boundary ω = T₂ ω + (-1 : ℝ) ^ p * T₁ ω) → ∃ Z E' : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Z ∧ BoundaryVanishes Z ∧ Z.support ⊆ B.support ∧ E'.mass ≤ T₂.mass ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U (n + 1), Z ω = T₁ ω + E' ω
